transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for offering to help with the plant care while the owner is away July 1 through July 14. As I mentioned, I have a sunny south-facing sunroom, and Marco and Talia, you've both offered to keep plants at your homes. Before I finalize the arrangement, I want to check with each of you about anything that should shape the care plan. We have three plants to place: a jade plant that needs strong direct light, an orchid that needs bright indirect light and humidity, and a Boston fern that does best in shade and steady moisture. The orchid also needs watering on July 2, 6, 10, and 14. Is there anything I should know about your spaces, schedules, or any concerns that would help me decide who takes which plant?
